cards.title: Document / Style
cards.body:
Character lineup model sheet · concept art sheet
#15 · Ghibli-Cel-Simulation · Wonder Project J2
Nintendo 64 (2D) / 1996
Artist ref: Akihiko Yamashita · J2 character-design reference (secondary)
Signature: Gentle cel-animation shapes, readable character acting

cards.title: Lineart
cards.body:
Fine, clean studio-animation contour
Expressive 1990s cel line
No pixel texture

cards.title: Morphology
cards.body:
Adult identity remains fixed
Tall, slim ectomorph with long limbs
No childlike or chibi proportions

cards.title: Shading
cards.body:
Crisp, simple two-tone cel shading
Warm, friendly animation light
Fixed material colors preserved

cards.title: Biotype
cards.body:
Selected: tall, slim ectomorph
Options: ectomorph · mesomorph · endomorph
muscular · petite · slim · athletic · curvy
heavy muscular · short

cards.title: Relative Scale
cards.body:
H = crown-to-chin head height · target ~7.5H
Orthographic views share scale and baseline
Visual guide, not canonical absolute height

cards.title: Palette / Effects
cards.body:
Fixed identity colors by material: blue/cyan, white, gray, burgundy, brown
Violet reserved for occult boomerang effect
Concept illustration; colors not quantized

cards.title: Background / Alignment
cards.body:
Clean neutral cream · no scenery or texture
Horizontal lineup · common scale and baseline

cards.title: Fixed Character Details
cards.body:
Gray hair · round brass glasses · cane · rapier
Steel crescent boomerang · fully human; no monster traits

artistic_style_reference.reference_role_and_scope: Secondary credits listing for Wonder Project J2 anime character design; not a Ghibli artist credit and not sole game-art authorship.
style_signature: expressive face and clear pose silhouette
artistic_style_reference.basis_and_limits: Do not equate the game with Studio Ghibli or attribute its art to Miyazaki; Ghibli-Simulation remains a style label, not a production credit.

annotation_revision.preserved_artwork_note: Artwork is preserved from the versioned source. For card-only revisions, all pixels outside the document/style card are unchanged.
